headline: UPI's transaction volume share
detail: Tracks UPI's share of total transaction volume across the study period using the cleaned payment dataset.

headline: UPI volume growth
detail: Measures the percentage change in UPI transaction volume between the first and last months of the study period.

headline: UPI's transaction value share
detail: Tracks UPI's share of the combined transaction value across the payment methods included in the dataset.

headline: UPI average ticket size
detail: Measures the change in UPI's average transaction value between the first and last months of the study period.
